stories.title: Election night: Linke wins Berlin; AfD narrowly leads SPD in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern — Merz stays

facts.text: Berlin (ZDF / Forschungsgruppe Wahlen Hochrechnung): Linke 25.5% (Eralp) clear of CDU 20% (Evers); Grüne 15.4%, AfD 13.9%, SPD 12%, BSW 5% — seat sketch 36/28/22/20/17/7 on 130 (ZDF).

Black-red Senate math collapses: CDU+SPD ~45 seats vs 66 needed; viable Dreier on paper are Linke–Grüne–SPD (75) or CDU–Grüne–SPD (67). Eralp claims Regierungsauftrag; SPD’s Krach calls result “katastrophal” (ZDF / rbb).
rbb / Infratest dimap ~18:56 Hochrechnung: Linke 24.9 / CDU 20.0 / AfD 15.7 / Grüne 15.0 / SPD 11.9 / BSW 5.0 — same Linke lead, AfD ahead of Grüne on that institute (rbb).

MV (ZDF Hochrechnung 19:01): AfD 37.9% (Holm) ahead of SPD 36.0% (Schwesig); Linke 6.5, Grüne 5.4, CDU 5.2, BSW 4.8 — five-party seat sketch AfD 30 / SPD 28 / Linke 5 / CDU+Grüne 4 each; majority 36 (ZDF).
Schwesig: AfD missed absolute majority; wants a stable democratic-party government. Merz calls MV CDU result a “Desaster,” vows to stay as chancellor and keep the reform course (ZDF / NDR).
Official counts still updating overnight: Berlin provisional ~01:30 Mon (berlin.de/wahlen); MV live maps via SZ while LAiV feeds catch election-night load (berlin.de / SZ).

stories.whyItMatters: Morning’s election-day setup is now Hochrechnung reality — two Land maps rewrite coalition math and keep Merz under Bund pressure without forcing him out tonight.

stories.title: LMU München: Immatrikulations-Stammdaten (inkl. IBAN) abgeflossen — LKA ermittelt

facts.text: LMU (Art. 34 notice, 19 Sep): unauthorized access to enrollment master data; university assumes the dataset was retrieved; no evidence yet of publication or misuse (LMU).
Categories may include name/DOB/addresses/emails, IBAN + account holder, BAföG numbers, health-insurance numbers, prior degrees / study-path data — exam results explicitly not affected (LMU / heise).
~53k enrolled; systems isolated, forensics + Bavarian LKA involved; winter-semester enrollment to resume next week with extended deadlines — “kein Nachteil für Ihr Studium” (heise / LMU).

stories.whyItMatters: A large German university just lost the full enrollment dossier — phishing and identity-fraud risk for students even if darknet dumps stay quiet.
